evidence: Every value the judge creates to prove a mutation is either generated fresh per review or explicitly named and absent from the seed and the reference's initial state. (1) Jobs and cards: constraints gate requires 'a unique title' and 'a unique name, a unique email address'; functional prompt.md line 11 and line 15 ('Use your own new jobs and cards for every board protocol (suffix every title and name for this review) ... never rely on starting counts'); polish and visual gates repeat the suffix rule. Seeded jobs are only Platform Engineer/Data Analyst/Product Designer (seed_data.json jobs), so no J1/J2/J3 or suffixed probe pre-exists. (2) Named literal probe: polish hro_pol_live_card example note 'Call back on Fri' - grep of environment/assets/seed_data.json, solution/app/src, server.js, public/, instructions and instruction.md finds 0 hits for 'Call back' and 'Fri'; polish prompt additionally says to record and clear any text left in a note/message box by an earlier review. hro_pol_failed_send and hro_pol_session_resume require a 'distinctive' reply. (3) Notes (hro_notes): seeded notes exist only on APP-101, APP-107, APP-301; the judge adds notes to new J1 cards, so no note is pre-present on the observed card. (4) Rejection (hro_reject_reason/hro_reopen): the only seeded rejected card is APP-301 Lena (Product Designer, reason 'Portfolio did not show shipped product work.'); the judge rejects its own new card C on J1, so reason/rejected-from cannot be pre-satisfied. (5) Candidate link (hro_candidate_linked): Tomas already has APP-201 Data Analyst in the seed, but the probe is a card on the fresh suffixed J2 (or J3 if already used), so the seeded application cannot satisfy 'the card added with Tomas's account email becomes Tomas's application'; the T fallback to the Data Analyst conversation is explicitly only for other rows and reads counts relative to pre-action values. (6) Conversations: T/U use Tomas's new J2 conversation, which starts empty; Noor/Lena readings are count-relative (Lena: 3 seeded APP-301 messages vs reads read_count 2 = 1 unread, matching 'starting read markers give her 1'). (7) Activity: db.js seeds users, jobs, applications, messages, reads, notes only - no activity rows - and the A protocol checks lines for the judge's own J1/J2 actions. (8) Restart (hro_restart) compares the judge's own recorded state and checks for duplicated starting data. Reference markup (public/index.html, js) contains none of these probe values; seed copies in environment/assets and solution/app/src are byte-identical. Adversarial tries: a broken app that never saves a new job/card/note/reason cannot pass because each probe is a fresh suffixed record the seed lacks; a broken app that pre-renders a fixed note or reason cannot match judge-chosen distinctive text. A conforming app is not failed by seed collisions because nothing graded depends on seeded values coinciding with probes. Minor observation (not a defect): functional message, note and reject-reason texts are not required to be distinctive, but each is observed on a fresh card or a fresh/empty conversation or by count, so a collision with seeded bodies cannot pre-satisfy a criterion. This is a static source property; no configured judge run was needed or used, and none is claimed.
